text:
Called in from patrol near Gretna MB. At approx 1100 May 26 spotted crude oil on the ground
at tank site. Called ops, they said meter shows 78.0 m³ synthetic crude released. Tank still
open, oil leaking from flange on outlet line. Temp was -12°C overnight, possible frozen valve
or seal. Crew on scene said they tested the line at 0800 and didn't catch the leak then. No
signs of third-party damage, looks like internal issue with valve or gasket.
Patrol contractor - J. Vos
